hens_rule_text: up to 6 chickens per family, only on a lot of at least 7,000 square feet with no more than one single-family home; combined small-animal total capped at 25
permit_notes: No chicken permit is mentioned in Chapter 6.04; the limits are lot size, count and placement.
setback_notes: Enclosure must be at least 50 feet from any residence other than the owner's and at least 5 feet from adjacent property lines.
coop_rules: Keep fowl in a building or fenced enclosure in the rear yard.
zoning_notes: The 7,000 square foot minimum lot with a single-family home is set in the code itself, so many smaller lots do not qualify.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.
